name: Balatonlelle (Hungary)
description: Red over green with a white canton bearing the town arms of Balatonlelle: a blue and green shield with a ploughshare and a fish, with a helm, a crest and red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Balatonlelle arms with helm, crest and mantling
